Protests in Delhi: Allegations of Police Brutality and Calls for Due Process

During protests in Delhi, the Students' Federation of India (SFI) has alleged police brutality and sexual harassment. Concurrently, opposition parties and the Centre for Public Interest Litigation (CJP) have vowed to continue protests, while the Supreme Court has emphasized the importance of due process amidst ongoing detentions. Journalists have also alleged police abuses during the demonstrations.
